recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current FHIR core source already satisfies FHIR-15688; adding patient-specified or discharge back into MedicationRequest.category would conflict with the resolved split and later category value set decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-15688 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 Pharmacy. It requested that MedicationRequest.category value set definitions stop referring only to orders, questioned adding a patient-specified category, and resolved to keep category focused on care setting, add a separate treatment/course attribute, and change orders wording to requests.
initial_application: The original application commit b87c1a290d1ad3d6e352f8bf4127fc61c949e67d updated MedicationRequest category prose and changed category code definitions from orders to requests. The linked treatment/course split was applied by ce698b9ee5288dac0d1f13735b92bb16a46c008d for GF/FHIR-17255, which added MedicationRequest.courseOfTherapyType.
additional_context: MedicationRequest is active and approved in source/fhir.ini. The current source has moved from spreadsheets to StructureDefinition, CodeSystem, and ValueSet XML. Later category decisions are relevant: FHIR-25555 removed discharge from medication category exemplar sets, and FHIR-51726 moved MedicationRequest category codes back into FHIR core with the current canonical. FHIR-17255, FHIR-25555, and FHIR-51726 are already represented on the combined branch and were used only as context here.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active MedicationRequest category CodeSystem now contains inpatient, outpatient, and community, with definitions that say requests rather than orders and no patient-specified or discharge concept. MedicationRequest.category remains bound to that category value set, while MedicationRequest.courseOfTherapyType separately represents the treatment/course pattern.

related_jiras.note: Added MedicationRequest.courseOfTherapyType, the separate treatment/course attribute referenced by FHIR-15688's application note.
Removed discharge from medication category exemplar value sets, explaining why the current MedicationRequest category CodeSystem has only inpatient, outpatient, and community.
Moved MedicationRequest category codes back into FHIR core and established the current medicationrequest-category CodeSystem/ValueSet identity.
